title: Henchmen
profile.title: Henchman profile
loyaltyHigh: Would take a death ray for you
loyaltyLow: Has been seen chatting with heroes
loyaltyHelp: Loyalty rises with paid overtime, a dry lair and fewer surprise trapdoors. It drops every time a henchman is blamed for a scheme they warned you about. Below 20%, expect a dramatic exit within the week.
assignSuccess: {{name}} is now on {{scheme}}. Try to keep them in one piece.
dramaticExitConfirm: Let {{name}} go with a dramatic exit? They will give a farewell speech, knock over at least one beaker and leave through the nearest window. Their gadgets stay in the lair. This can't be undone.
empty.title: No henchmen yet
empty.body: Minions do the heavy lifting. Henchmen do the heavy lifting while looking menacing in a good suit. Hire your first one and give them a scheme worth sneering about.
